items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: That's when I played that season with the Tuxedo Band. I'll give you the members of that band. ... first had Bill Matthew on trombone

ctx.x: That was the Young Morgan Band. Well, they called it Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. But, say, Sammy got the best go year. You know, Johnny Day, I picked him right now, standing on Seminole in Claiborne waiting to catch the North Claiborne called the Ride Up Canal Street. Yeah. Well, that same year you're speaking about was John Morrell had got several fellas out there in the tuxedo band to make that record. I see. And he had wanted, Chani Bebe was the drummer, you see, but he was a crack…
So Paul Barch wasn't doing that band anymore then? Who? Paul Barch was gone. Oh no, no. He was up in New York that time.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: It was the Tuxedo band... Now, he had Bill Matthew, trombone... He wanted me on drum.

ctx.x: Do you remember us was on that recording, Dave? Can you remember that?

Who was on that recording? Yeah, can you remember that? Let me see, yeah, I might have seen it now. It was... Let me see. John, it was John Murray. It was the Tuxedo band, but it was John's record. I had numbers. I think he had... Let me see. Now, he had Bill Matthew, trombone. He didn't use record. I think he had these... He wanted me on drum. He had... I think he had Jeanette. Let me see. I think Jeanette's playing piano. And Paul Bones. Sam Segarra. He didn't have the song. Sam Segarra, I think, was playing…
It was on trumpets. Can you remember the trumpets?
